## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The two-juan table of contents to Fèiyǐn Tōngróng's 25-juan *Wǔdēng yántǒng* 五燈嚴統 ([KR6q0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0019)), the controversial 1653 Línjì-orthodox revision of the *Wǔdēng huìyuán* 五燈會元 ([KR6q0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0012)). Separately catalogued in the Xuzangjing.

**Abstract**

Finding-aid for the parent work. See [KR6q0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0019) for its content and the controversy it generated.
